about: opus-first 10:06 — a 10-unit enemy push arrives at the base just after our army left
opus_decided: recall everything, stance defend, clear the attack target

situation.rules: The game is lost if our commander dies.
situation.what_just_happened: A large enemy group of ten units has arrived at our base. Our eight combat units left the base half a minute ago towards the middle of the map and are still close.
situation.our_base: Six defensive turrets, the commander, one factory.

army_order.instructions: Choose what our eight units that just left should do now, given `situation`.

criteria.return_and_defend: Turn around and fight the enemy group at our base.
criteria.continue_attack: Keep going to the middle of the map as planned.
criteria.counterattack_enemy_base: Ignore the attack and go for the enemy's base while their army is away.
criteria.none_of_these: None of the listed orders fits.

commander_in_danger.instructions: Is our commander in serious danger right now?

threat_level.instructions: How severe is the threat to our base described in `situation`?
criteria: No threat: nothing hostile near the base.
Nuisance: one or two raiders the turrets will handle.
Serious: an enemy group that can destroy buildings unless our army responds.
Critical: an enemy force that can overrun the base and kill the commander.
